svg.aria-label: Which packages import which: cmd/apranik/cli at the top imports config and core; core packages import down through builder, inbound, handler, router and relay to the leaf packages. module/* and shared/* sit below and are imported by core/registry. Modules never import core or each other.
svg.title: Package dependencies

g.text: Which core packages import which (only the direct edges; spec, core/stats, core/logging, core/component, core/net/udp, config/types, shared/* and module/* left out)
module/* and shared/*: imported by core/registry, and by core/builder for tcp and udp. Modules import only spec, config/types and shared/*.
shared/*: one concept each, spec and the standard library only

text.tspan: transport/overlay: tls · websocket · httpupgrade · fragment · proxyprotocol
proxy: socks5 · http · trojan · vless (each with its wire package)
Modules never import another module or core. spec imports nothing from the project; every package imports spec.
controlcharacter · delayedrequest · dnsstream · httpstatusranges · lru · muxcool · originalsourceip
